questions.question_text: Which of the following studies do NOT need to be included in your UAC application because institutions do not take them into account?
options: Completed Bachelor degrees
Year 12 results
AQF Certificate I or II
Diploma studies
questions.explanation: UAC and universities generally only look at higher-level qualifications. Certificates I and II are not considered for admission purposes.

questions.question_text: If you are an interstate Year 12 applicant, when can you generally apply for most courses through UAC?
options: Immediately at the start of the year
After 1 August
Only after you receive your final results in December
Once you have graduated from university
questions.explanation: UAC requires access to your student ID details which usually become available from state authorities around 1 August.

questions.question_text: Which of the following studies do NOT need to be included in your UAC application because they are not typically considered by institutions?
options: Completed Bachelor degrees
Completed Year 12 studies
AQF Certificates I and II
Tertiary preparation courses
questions.explanation: Institutions generally do not take into account AQF Certificates I and II, Statements of Attainment, or unaccredited courses, so these do not need to be included.

questions.question_text: How can an International Baccalaureate (IB) student in Australia ensure UAC receives their final results?
options: Wait for a paper copy and mail it to UAC
Ask their IB Diploma coordinator to authorise the release of results directly to UAC
Request the results from the university directly
Scan the results and upload them to the application manually
questions.explanation: IB students should ask their school's IB Diploma coordinator to authorise the release of their results directly to UAC to ensure the process is automated.

questions.question_text: What information must an official academic transcript include for it to be accepted?
options: Only the final graduation date
A summary of non-academic school activities
The title of the course, subjects taken, and grades obtained
A letter of recommendation from a teacher
questions.explanation: Official transcripts must clearly show the course title, all subjects taken, and all grades obtained, including any failures.

questions.question_text: Why must you provide a copy of your grading scale with your international academic transcripts?
options: To prove you paid for your course
To help UAC interpret your grades in the context of your institution's marking system
To confirm your date of birth
Because it is a requirement for your student visa
questions.explanation: A grading scale is necessary to help UAC understand what your results mean within the context of the specific institution's assessment system.

questions.question_text: Which of the following does NOT need to be included in your UAC application?
options: Completed Australian Year 12 studies
Completed university degrees
Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF) Certificates I and II
Previous incomplete diploma studies
questions.explanation: Institutions generally do not consider AQF Certificates I or II, or TAFE statements, so these do not need to be included in your application.

questions.question_text: How do Australian Year 12 students typically provide their results to UAC?
options: By mailing a physical copy of their final report card
By scanning and uploading their final exam results
UAC automatically receives the results from the relevant authority
By having their school principal email them to UAC
questions.explanation: UAC receives official results directly from Australian Year 12 assessment authorities, so students typically do not need to upload them.

questions.question_text: What must be included if you are providing international academic transcripts that are not in English?
options: A summary written by the student
An official English translation by an approved authority
Only the original document
A letter from your embassy
questions.explanation: Non-English transcripts must be accompanied by an official translation from a certified or approved translator to be accepted.

questions.question_text: What is a 'Combined Rank' for IB students?
options: The sum of all subject grades
A value used by universities to compare IB results with ATAR students
The number of subjects passed
The total number of bonus points achieved
questions.explanation: UAC converts the IB Admissions Score (IBAS) into a 'Combined Rank' so that it is comparable with the ATAR for university entry.

questions.question_text: If UAC cannot obtain your transcript directly, what must it include for it to be accepted?
options: Only the final grade received
The course title, subjects taken, grades obtained, and proof of completion
A handwritten note confirming your attendance
Only the official school stamp
questions.explanation: Official transcripts must be comprehensive, showing the course, all subjects, all grades (including failures), and proof that the course was completed.
